source.title: 阿瓦隆线上赛第一名来踢馆，教你玩派西维尔如何速通

interval.rationale: Usable window of this upload. 0-238 s is a teaser ('正片跳转至3分58秒' burned into the first frames) replaying later clips out of order. From ~1273 s the edit switches to '狼人盘刀' (the evil team choosing an assassination target) and then '赛后'; both are answer-bearing and are excluded by live_game_interval rather than by the extraction interval, so the boundary itself stays visible in the evidence. The extraction runs 12 s past the switch so the reviewer can see where it happens.

basis.player_count: client seat strip shows seats 1-10; panel header reads 已入座 10/10
basis.mission_team_sizes: client panel: 第1轮·需3人, 第2轮·需4人, 第3轮·需4人. Missions 4-5 were never reached in this upload and their sizes are NOT stated anywhere, so they are not listed.
basis.proposal_limit: mission 1 shows three proposals and the third is marked 必做轮 and resolved as 自动通过 (no vote)
basis.final_proposal_forced: the third proposal of mission 1 auto-passed with no vote chips
basis.fails_required: not shown by this client for any mission; the listed 1/1/1 is the standard rule for missions 1-3 of a 10-player game and is NOT observed here.
basis.lady_of_the_lake: In play in this game. Corroborated INSIDE the usable window by public speech (seat 5 says 我可是出身高贵的仙女牌; seat 9 says 你是尊贵的湖仙; seat 3 discusses 湖仙 藏票). The client's own 湖中仙女 row — which names the holder, the target AND the resulting role — first appears at 1270.02 s, OUTSIDE live_game_interval, so neither the check nor its result is in the record, and the timing of the check is not asserted.
basis.role_composition: end-of-video seat strip reveals 莫德雷德/莫甘娜/奥伯伦/刺客 as the four evil roles, leaving merlin+percival+4 loyal; matches the standard 10-player set with Oberon
